summary: 73 features and 37 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • hero-models: rank catalog models by CLI preferences (f30d01d)
  • system-info: expose Turbo Engine purchase guidance (19b4607)
  • agent-cli: publish the canonical feature and provider contract (40034c5)
  • skills: report scan issues and skill status counts (fac0bf1)
  • hagitask: apply the saved Git profile to Super Commit (f42f39c)
  • system-info: expose the host version through gRPC (a66b733)
  • skills: exclude selected folders from user skill bases (7224730)
  • skills: discover user skills recursively (3df79b9)
  • saga: restrict Saga workers to the selected Hero route (660016a)
  • sessions: allow host paths outside workspace roots (5ca8424)
  • scheduled-plans: add preflight checks and daily occurrences (6c984ac)
  • hero: add favorites and marker-free model settings API (01d51ee)
  • hero-catalog: add DeepSeek V4 model options (3d2ef66)
  • magpie: route ready model catalogs through executor CLIs (b7190db)
  • saga-overview: expose bound control sessions (4ba045a)
  • proposals: make automatic generation a session choice (08b7636)
  • providers: retire Reasonix CLI execution safely (d70bc0c)
  • magpie: integrate gateway catalogs and usage monitoring (1dc8f03)
  • session-agent-switch: continue stopped sessions across executors (61c185e)
  • session-heroes: bind fallback Heroes to new chats (95a1e2a)
  • session-images: resolve paths from target repositories (dc92b24)
  • host-path-launch: allow desktop path launching across deployments (dcdf5fe)
  • scheduled-plans: add fixed interval recurrence rules (2a9ee02)
  • agent-context: expose session context to provider runs (2ff4320)
  • session-messaging: add session question answering RPCs (557fc01)
  • saga: keep Saga data and edit scope at the project root (d4fd0e8)
  • copilot: use saved Agent settings for message model and tier (b672b83)

HagiCode-org/web

  • hero: rank compatible models and show preference groups (aa181cc)
  • ambient: add Turbo Engine purchase guidance card (951abad)
  • skill-gallery: expose scan totals and issue details (f853921)
  • agent-cli: centralize provider identity and capabilities (960e51d)
  • skills: show scan totals and errors for skill bases (8a8cd49)
  • ambient: link slot rotation and add manual gestures (99810ed)
  • proposal: move auto-generation choice into more options (a2cf06b)
  • i18n: translate mobile About section (8ef98d9)
  • mobile: add an About section to Settings (c0598f1)
  • lib: expose server version and community link (239c636)
  • skills: add folder exclusion RPC types (1098531)
  • i18n: translate custom skill folder exclusions (8c8fea8)
  • skills: exclude folders from custom skill base searches (ec9fdb2)
  • i18n: localize ambient and skill base updates (82316a1)
  • skills: add multiple skill bases from path lists (9bceeab)
  • web: animate ambient readouts across workspace surfaces (7138103)
  • web: show repeated scheduled plan times (fdc0d1b)
  • web: add configurable ambient information slots (3ef318d)
  • i18n: update Hero, plan, and statusbar translations (e422ec2)
  • web: save and apply Hero scenario roster favorites (99179d4)
  • web: configure scheduled-plan preflight checks (a8d0e94)
  • web: combine TokenMonitor usage and history drawer (4edda53)
  • web: add Magpie gateway settings and model catalog (20247b0)
  • i18n: localize updated web and mobile experiences (5d2091c)
  • web: carry auto-generation choice into new sessions (89809e2)
  • web: open bound sessions from Saga status rows (4b5c393)
  • web: add Magpie gateway support to TokenMonitor settings (2e6ce86)
  • web: localize the TokenMonitor report experience (b96e867)
  • web: add TokenMonitor details to daily reports (65aa324)
  • web: add hourly TokenMonitor report model and visuals (e983dfb)
  • web: show Saga progress across its summary views (5b9c05a)
  • web: preserve full labels across shared UI surfaces (6241bf8)
  • web: improve keyboard navigation and labels in settings (5a65cf4)
  • web: add keyboard navigation to library rows (6393f44)
  • web: improve keyboard access for hero management (f8b36ed)
  • web: add interval-based scheduled plan recurrence (0996df9)
  • web: clarify busy actions and cue Super Commit readiness (b95e534)
  • web: add keyboard navigation to the Kanban board (ff85535)
  • web: improve Git repository guidance and keyboard access (afbbf33)
  • web: add keyboard navigation to session rows (cd1f634)
  • web: add keyboard navigation to the project list (c7da638)
  • web: make shell actions easier to navigate by keyboard (fba1c3a)
  • web: add browser checks for key UI surfaces (c7120d2)
  • theme-audit: add sampled browser checks for theme rendering (bfc807e)
  • theme-audit: track declared surfaces and migrations (a1b14fa)
  • themes: generate legacy family styles from catalog sources (78242c3)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • sessions: allow local images outside session roots (67d2ad8)
  • providers: reject unknown names and support Omp CLI (2f04e22)
  • omp: append assistant fragments without dropping repeated text (984d01e)
  • hero: request deactivation after failed favorite recovery (e9a34b9)
  • sessions: allow escaped paths in Code Server launches (badc9f3)
  • proposals: honor executor planning direction defaults (de31e60)
  • copilot: keep subagent output separate from main streams (e549e2c)
  • hero-prompts: escape inline trait and soul content (0a928e4)
  • hero-switch: honor active bindings and user mode (96ccd25)

HagiCode-org/web

  • mobile: align Agent CLI icons with the web cat sheet (b008186)
  • ux: align the Hero conflict fixture with backend errors (1b92619)
  • web: keep repository details from covering nearby cards (4bc9a5c)
  • web: preserve interleaved Copilot response fragments (591f5c2)
  • web: open settings for retired OmniRoute deep links (489425a)
  • web: guard tab switches with unsaved settings (88d319c)
  • mobile: resolve session and interface audit findings (f04500f)
  • web: compare version prerelease labels in ASCII order (8213136)
  • web: preserve history for retired provider sessions (2b4a5c1)
  • web: fit TokenMonitor reports to shorter viewports (72f5c27)
  • web: allow stopped sessions to switch agents (af6008d)
  • web: keep TokenMonitor report chart labels readable (a9f2625)
  • web: order hourly TokenMonitor pace by timestamp (7a93005)
  • web: align tool status accents with theme tokens (4b0b58b)
  • web: make remaining interface colors follow theme tokens (66fc04c)
  • web: hide archived-only projects from large matrices (beda406)
  • web: wrap long labels in the Global View card (5f9671c)
  • web: improve shared accessibility and state feedback (63713e3)
  • web: clarify hydration reminders and report states (eb3fce2)
  • web: explain blocked conversation actions to keyboard users (9273c4d)
  • tools: guard tool kind lookups against inherited keys (e162837)
  • web: keep fallback hero scenario icons above the fade (045ad02)
  • web: read repository tone hues from their owning package (7e9cab7)
  • web: stabilize and refine theme render contrast sampling (5d9992e)
  • web: scale project avatar initials to fit compact session rows (84340ab)
  • web: improve contrast across status and achievement indicators (ad3f08b)
  • themes: improve contrast in hero and achievement labels (47dabd8)
  • themes: improve contrast across application surfaces (28229ad)
